name: Spellwise
description:
Your time among students of magic has allowed you to pick up a simple spell.

When you choose your mestiere, you may gain one additional spell ability with an XP cost of 5 or less for free. If your mestiere does not include any such spell abilities, you may instead choose and gain an ability from one of the Arcanist schools with an XP cost of 5 or less.

Describe how you learned this spell.
